games.name: Baldur's Gate 3
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's 2024 winners release names Baldur's Gate 3 the Best Game winner.

mechanics.name: reactive choices
mechanics.detail: Choices leave marks on the world and companions react to them.

mechanics.name: turn-based party play
mechanics.detail: Evolved turn-based combat and recruitable companions support varied builds.

games.return_reason: Inferred: consequential choices, companion arcs, and build experimentation invite another campaign.
games.allworld_transfer: Persistent residents can remember civic choices, form relationships, and unlock mission roles or careers.
games.risk: A branching campaign can be expensive to author and difficult to keep coherent.

games.name: Elden Ring
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's 2023 winners release names Elden Ring the Original Property winner.

mechanics.name: open exploration
mechanics.detail: An immense world hides secrets and rewards players who leave the beaten path.

mechanics.name: co-op and builds
mechanics.detail: Players can co-op against powerful foes and shape characters through classes, gear, magic, and skills.

games.return_reason: Inferred: discovery, difficult mastery, and radically different builds create reasons to return.
games.allworld_transfer: Let residents uncover hidden city opportunities, choose specialties, and call human or AI allies into missions.
games.risk: Punishing failure and opaque progression can exclude casual residents.

games.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
games.award_evidence: CD PROJEKT RED's official 2015 announcement states The Witcher 3 won The Game Awards' Game of the Year.

mechanics.name: quest choice
mechanics.detail: Plot-driven RPG structure is combined with open-world freedom of choice.

mechanics.name: large quest world
mechanics.detail: The Complete Edition describes 100+ hours of core and side-quest gameplay plus expansions.

games.return_reason: Inferred: morally difficult quests and alternate outcomes motivate replay and discussion.
games.allworld_transfer: Use local notices, relationships, and branching missions so city choices alter reputations and later work.
games.risk: High-volume authored quests can overwhelm players and production budgets.

games.name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim
games.award_evidence: The Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences' 2012 results name Skyrim Game of the Year.

mechanics.name: skill-led identity
mechanics.detail: Skills such as Destruction, Archery, and Speech shape the character's trajectory.

mechanics.name: freeform world
mechanics.detail: Players can follow quests or wander into dungeons and side stories at their own pace.

games.return_reason: Inferred: self-directed builds and emergent stories make each character's journey feel different.
games.allworld_transfer: Offer careers, homes, skills, and city factions that let each resident write a distinct life path.
games.risk: Unstructured choice needs strong onboarding and readable goals.

games.name: Mass Effect 2
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's 2011 winners release names Mass Effect 2 the Best Game winner.

mechanics.name: loyalty crew
mechanics.detail: The core mission structure recruits squadmates and gives them personal missions.

mechanics.name: squad preparation
mechanics.detail: Recruit squadmates and prepare a team for the suicide mission.

games.return_reason: Inferred: attachment to a crew and high-stakes preparation make the finale personally consequential.
games.allworld_transfer: Give AI agents loyalty arcs, trust thresholds, and mission assignments that change outcomes.
games.risk: Relationship systems can flatten into optimal checklists if consequences are predictable.

games.name: Dragon Age: Inquisition
games.award_evidence: The Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences' 2015 results name Dragon Age: Inquisition Game of the Year.

mechanics.name: reactive regions
mechanics.detail: Areas contain factions, ecosystems, and opportunities that shift with player actions.

mechanics.name: relationships and choices
mechanics.detail: BioWare describes choices, foes vanquished, relationships forged, and world-state customization.

games.return_reason: Inferred: changing regions and companion relationships make the world feel responsive to the player's leadership.
games.allworld_transfer: Model neighbourhoods as living systems where resident actions shift safety, faction trust, and available work.
games.risk: Emergent simulation needs transparent feedback so changes feel earned.

games.name: Disco Elysium
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's 2020 winners release names Disco Elysium the Narrative winner.

mechanics.name: dialogue skill checks
mechanics.detail: Active checks make skills expand or constrain dialogue options, with rewards and punishments.

mechanics.name: internal voices
mechanics.detail: Skills can speak back to the detective and propose radically different conversational options.

games.return_reason: Inferred: roleplay through ideology, voice, and failure creates unusually personal detective stories.
games.allworld_transfer: Give residents competing needs and inner-agent traits that alter dialogue, reputation, and mission resolution.
games.risk: Dense text and ambiguous objectives may reduce accessibility and session clarity.

games.name: Divinity: Original Sin 2
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's 2018 results name Divinity: Original Sin 2 the Multiplayer winner.

mechanics.name: reactive sandbox
mechanics.detail: The story reacts to who the player is and what the player has done.

mechanics.name: cooperative party
mechanics.detail: The official product description positions it as a cooperative sandbox RPG with a narrative-driven world.

games.return_reason: Inferred: systemic problem solving and co-op disagreement produce memorable, non-identical runs.
games.allworld_transfer: Support shared city missions where human and AI residents can pursue conflicting solutions.
games.risk: Systemic freedom increases QA scope and can make authored social consequences unpredictable.

games.name: Persona 5
games.award_evidence: SEGA's official 2017 announcement confirms Persona 5 won Best Role-Playing Game at The Game Awards.

mechanics.name: school-and-night loop
mechanics.detail: The setting pairs everyday teenage life with supernatural battles and a long-form story.

mechanics.name: relationships and combat
mechanics.detail: Japan Game Awards describes growth, command battles, and substantial replayable content.

games.return_reason: Inferred: calendar choices, social bonds, and build planning make a campaign feel like a lived routine.
games.allworld_transfer: Combine daily schedules, resident bonds, careers, and night missions in one city progression loop.
games.risk: Time pressure can make players fear missing content and follow guides instead of roleplaying.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's 2025 results name Metaphor: ReFantazio the Narrative winner.

mechanics.name: Archetype jobs
mechanics.detail: Official Atlus material presents Archetype lineages, evolution, synthesis, and party configuration.

mechanics.name: Follower bonds
mechanics.detail: Atlus describes bonding with Followers to awaken new Archetypes.

games.return_reason: Inferred: deadlines, follower bonds, and flexible jobs reward planning and alternate builds.
games.allworld_transfer: Tie resident relationships to unlockable professions, mission abilities, and civic leadership paths.
games.risk: Calendar deadlines can create anxiety and encourage min-maxing.

games.name: Monster Hunter: World

award.name: Japan Game Awards
award.category: Games of the Year Division Grand Award

games.award_evidence: Capcom's official announcement states Monster Hunter: World won the 2018 Japan Game Awards Grand Award.

mechanics.name: cooperative hunting
mechanics.detail: Hunt large monsters across connected maps and let friends join quests in progress.

mechanics.name: seamless multiplayer
mechanics.detail: The award announcement highlights seamless area transitions and joining friends mid-quest.

games.return_reason: Inferred: target mastery, gear upgrades, and co-op create an ongoing reason to take the next hunt.
games.allworld_transfer: Create repeatable civic missions with role-based teams, escalating threats, and visible equipment mastery.
games.risk: A repeatable loop needs enough authored variety to avoid chore fatigue.

games.name: Monster Hunter Rise

award.name: Japan Game Awards
award.category: Games of the Year Division Grand Award

games.award_evidence: Capcom's official announcement states Monster Hunter Rise won the 2021 Japan Game Awards Grand Award.

mechanics.name: Wirebug traversal
mechanics.detail: The official award record describes Wirebugs, Wyvern Riding, new quests, and 14 weapon types.

mechanics.name: hunt-craft progression
mechanics.detail: Hunters gather materials to produce and strengthen weapons and armor, alone or with up to four players.

games.return_reason: Inferred: mobile traversal, mastery, and gear pursuit support short sessions and long-term hunting goals.
games.allworld_transfer: Offer city traversal tools, collectible materials, and cooperative missions that improve resident capability.
games.risk: Equipment optimization can overshadow social storytelling if rewards are purely numerical.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth
games.award_evidence: PlayStation's official 2024 Partner Awards results name Final Fantasy VII Rebirth a Grand Award recipient.

mechanics.name: party synergy
mechanics.detail: Synergy abilities and party level grow as team affinity deepens.

mechanics.name: exploration playground
mechanics.detail: Square Enix emphasizes expansive regions, secrets, skirmishes, stories, and exploration.

games.return_reason: Inferred: discovery, party bonds, and varied activities sustain exploration beyond the critical path.
games.allworld_transfer: Make companion affinity unlock coordinated missions, while city regions hide optional stories and resources.
games.risk: Large activity maps can dilute the emotional focus of the main story.

games.name: Final Fantasy XVI

award.name: Japan Game Awards
award.category: Games of the Year Division Award for Excellence

games.award_evidence: CESA's official 2024 Japan Game Awards results name Final Fantasy XVI an Award for Excellence recipient.

mechanics.name: real-time combat
mechanics.detail: Square Enix calls it the first true action RPG in the mainline series, with dynamic real-time combat and RPG features.

mechanics.name: Eikonic abilities
mechanics.detail: Clive uses multiple Eikons and their powers in breakneck battle.

games.return_reason: Inferred: spectacle, mastery, and new Eikon moves provide immediate reasons to continue a linear campaign.
games.allworld_transfer: Use role-based resident abilities and major mission unlocks to make career growth visible in action.
games.risk: A combat-led loop transfers less directly to quiet social-life play.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Remake
games.award_evidence: Square Enix's official recap confirms Final Fantasy VII Remake won Best RPG at The Game Awards 2020.

mechanics.name: hybrid combat
mechanics.detail: Square Enix describes real-time action with tactical command options and customizable combat modes.

mechanics.name: Midgar story setting
mechanics.detail: The standalone story follows Midgar's characters and Avalanche resistance missions.

games.return_reason: Inferred: tightly authored urban districts, party bonds, and side stories reward a complete campaign and replay.
games.allworld_transfer: Translate district-based missions, community reputation, and party skill combinations into a persistent city.
games.risk: A strongly linear structure may limit resident-led emergence.

games.name: NieR: Automata
games.award_evidence: Square Enix's official award record lists NieR: Automata as The Game Awards 2017 Best Score/Music winner.

mechanics.name: multi-character combat
mechanics.detail: PlatinumGames presents 2B as a combat android and 9S as a scanner android in the YoRHa conflict.

mechanics.name: action RPG combat
mechanics.detail: The official developer page describes combat across a desolate open world.

games.return_reason: Inferred: changing viewpoints and layered routes encourage players to revisit the same world for new meaning.
games.allworld_transfer: Let resident roles reveal different views of the same city crisis and unlock alternate mission paths.
games.risk: Narrative repetition needs clear signposting so players understand why returning matters.

unverified.reason: Reserved for a later batch per brief; not researched here.
